notes: Microsoft Azure Sweden South region facility at Vastanvagen 86, Staffanstorp (Malmo-Lund axis). Region launched late 2021; Microsoft officially confirms datacenters in Gavle, Sandviken and Staffanstorp. 2022 expansion plan at Staffanstorp was dropped (DCD); Microsoft later announced deployment of 20,000 GPUs in Sweden. Site about 17 football pitches; part of Sweden South Azure region.
